RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 0

Both you and the successful candidate are men, and a man was appointed. An all-male panel selecting one man over another provides no evidence of sex discrimination against you. Raising the panel's gender composition would appear unfounded and could harm your professional reputation.

The outcome likely hinged on specific institutional priorities, such as the appointed candidate's regulatory affairs background, leadership fit, or interview performance. While an all-male panel may reflect broader diversity deficits within the bank's senior leadership, it was not a disadvantage to you on the basis of sex. Focus instead on sending a polite follow-up to request the constructive feedback you were promised.
